svg.title: OneGrid - enterprise landing zone implementation
svg.desc: Add enterprise ingress, private connectivity, DNS, egress and governance around the same OneGrid application and data services

g.title: Enterprise users - Approved browser / API access Hybrid network or internet ingress
Browser map endpoints - Azure Maps / Esri / glyphs
DNS Private Resolver - Private-zone links Hybrid DNS forwarding
Azure Firewall - Approved outbound endpoints UDR / egress policy

text.tspan: Enterprise networking layer | separate from the baseline ARM deployment

g.title: Application Gateway - WAF / TLS / WebSocket Approved entry point
App Service endpoint - Private inbound app access Origin access restricted
Dependency endpoints - Fabric / Blob / Azure OpenAI Tenant Fabric Private Link Service-specific DNS / access

text.tspan: Dedicated delegated subnet | outbound application and configuration routing

g.title: App Service VNet integration - Outbound virtual interface; not the inbound application endpoint
Microsoft Entra ID - Sign-in / groups / access policy
Azure App Service - OneGrid / managed identity Service-hosted compute Outside the integration subnet
Microsoft Fabric - Tenant-level Private Link Separate source egress
Azure Blob Storage - Assets / package / outputs Private DNS + authorization
Azure OpenAI - Approved model endpoint Region / processing policy
Azure Machine Learning - Workspace PE for inbound Managed network for outbound
Approved public APIs - GeoCatalog / Entra / ARM Explicit endpoint allowlist
Aurora forecast job - Own environment / DNS / egress NOAA / registry / Blob channel

text.tspan: Policy / RBAC / budgets / change approvals / central monitoring | validate runner, package-bootstrap and source-ingestion paths before restricting endpoints
Add enterprise ingress, private connectivity, DNS, egress and governance around the same OneGrid application and data services
Arrowheads indicate the initiator of a request or the destination of data. Optional components are labeled; dashed boundaries mark a separately controlled scope.
